content:
The latest iOS beta version of WhatsApp has introduced a set of improved chat customisation options, including dynamic wallpapers. Here are the details.

According to reports, the animation effects will be more intricate.

WABetaInfo discovered that the latest WhatsApp beta version distributed via TestFlight contains some features that they had previously found in the Android WhatsApp beta: a brand new set of chat themes divided into three categories — "Featured", "Doodle" and "Minimal".

According to the report, "Doodle" will offer wallpapers inspired by WhatsApp's classic doodle patterns, while "Minimal" will use a pure white or pure black background depending on whether the user has light or dark mode enabled. As for "Featured", it will include wallpapers with intricate dynamic effects.

Below is the content from WABetaInfo:

The site also mentions that the colour of the chat bubbles will vary depending on the wallpaper, with WhatsApp automatically selecting the colour rather than letting users customise it separately.

WABetaInfo stated that this feature is still under development and has not yet been made available to beta testers. However, since WhatsApp is currently developing it for both iOS and Android simultaneously, it should not be too long before some beta testers get to see it ahead of its official release.
